Enum Class DurationFormat.Unit

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<DurationFormat.Unit>
org.springframework.format.annotation.DurationFormat.Unit
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<DurationFormat.Unit>, Constable
Enclosing class:
DurationFormat
public static enum DurationFormat.Unit extends Enum<DurationFormat.Unit>
Duration format unit, which mirrors a subset of ChronoUnit and allows conversion to and from a supported ChronoUnit as well as conversion from durations to longs.

枚举在其对应的后缀中包含在 `SIMPLE` Duration 格式样式中。

Since:
6.2
Author:
Simon Baslé

    • longValue

      public long longValue(Duration value)
      Convert the given Duration to a long value in the resolution of this unit.

      请注意，如果当前单位大于持续时间的实际分辨率，则可能会发生精度丢失。例如，`Duration.ofMillis(5).plusNanos(1234)` 在单位为 `MILLIS` 时会被截断为 `5`。

      Parameters:
      value - 要转换为长整型的 Duration
      Returns:
      此Unit中Duration的长整型值
